findings.body: Malformed topic labels can count as settled answers. For example, `- Sign-in method: email and password (client, 2026-09-28)` is associated with `Sign-in` by the prefix check, and ANSWER_LINE accepts the altered label. Consequently, `forge next` omits Sign-in even though its required exact-name entry is missing. Validate the matched label against the exact topic before accepting an answer, while retaining malformed entries as open.
findings.title: Not done: forge next lists what is still open

findings.body: A deferred entry such as `- Production host: later, when procurement approves (client, 2026-09-28)` matches both patterns. Because the ordinary-answer branch wins, it stores `later, when procurement approves` instead of the `later` marker. The exact comparison in open_must_answer_topics then treats this required topic as settled. Give the deferral format precedence so adding source/date information cannot remove an unresolved topic from the list.
findings.title: Recognize dated deferrals before ordinary answers
